name: package-guard
description: Package Guard — package security auditing and management for Windows.
author: Lupus Venture

scripts.clean:all: pnpm run clean && rimraf node_modules/.pnpm && pnpm -r run clean
scripts.dev: concurrently "pnpm --filter @packageguard/desktop-renderer dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 NODE_ENV=development electron ."
scripts.build: pnpm run build:libs && pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm run build:cli-exe && pnpm run build:modules && pnpm run build:electron
scripts.build:libs: pnpm --filter @packageguard/shared build && pnpm --filter @packageguard/database build && pnpm --filter @packageguard/cli build
scripts.build:electron: cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false USE_HARD_LINKS=false NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 electron-builder --config build/electron-builder.config.js --publish never
scripts.dist:dir: pnpm run build:libs && pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm run build:cli-exe && pnpm run build:modules && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false USE_HARD_LINKS=false electron-builder --config build/electron-builder.config.js --dir --publish never
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm --filter @packageguard/desktop-renderer --filter @packageguard/cli --if-present run typecheck
